premises.text: People default to familiar places because they fear a new place will be a bad experience
premises.evidence_span: we don't want to take the chance and try to go to a new place because we're not sure that we're going to like the experience

premises.text: SpotOn builds personalized actionable place recommendations from Facebook and Foursquare social data
premises.evidence_span: pulling in your existing social network data from Facebook and Foursquare

premises.text: A social layer surfaces friends' ratings, visits, saves, and who to go with—not anonymous reviewers
premises.evidence_span: Every single place has a social layer that pulls in reasons why you should go check out a place

premises.text: Fun in-app rating of check-ins gathers preference data that improves recommendations for the contributor and others
premises.evidence_span: we make it really easy for our users to give us a lot of their preference data in a really fun and an engaging way

premises.text: Filters and personalized search let users find friend-visited or never-been places with personalized categories
premises.evidence_span: only show me places that at least one of my friends have been to, or only show me places that I've never been to

value.text: Easiest way to go to new places with friends and enjoy the end experience together
value.evidence_span: SpotOn is the easiest way to go to new places with your friends

causal_links.evidence_span: we don't want to take the chance and try to go to a new place
find a place that you're enjoying, spend more time actually enjoying the place with your friends

notes: Map pins, pix view, place detail, activity feed folded as cascade of personalized social discovery product (§4.1.7). Group-recommendation/plan pipeline treated as roadmap vision, not separate premises (§4.1.4). Two domains—problem vs product—not a need/product/money triad.
